selected_script.angle: Absurd husband scuba diver rescues family shower drain using grey silicone hair catcher
selected_script.hook: Water pooling around a messy hair clog in the shower drain

usage_steps_used: Clean and wipe dry the area around the drain opening
Place the Hair Catcher directly over the drain opening
Press down firmly on the corner suction cups
Use shower as usual and lift/remove caught hair from the dome as needed

script_record.pain_point: Shower water pooling due to messy hair clog on drain
script_record.conflict_hook: POV of shower water backing up around a hair-clogged drain
script_record.product_solution: Wiping the smooth surface dry, placing the Kitsch silicone hair catcher, and pressing the corner suction cups down firmly to block hair while letting water drain.

timeline.scene: Close-up POV of soapy water pooling and backing up around a clogged, hair-filled shower drain. No product, no rescuer.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: An absurd husband wearing a black scuba wetsuit and snorkel mask enters holding the grey silicone Kitsch Hair Catcher. He moves directly to the drain and says: 'No more clogs!'
The husband wipes dry the smooth tile drain surface, places the grey silicone catcher directly over the drain, and presses down firmly on the corner suction cups against the smooth tile surface.
Water drains smoothly through the perforated top dome of the grey hair catcher on the shower floor.
Fast-cut showing the grey hair catcher installed over a smooth bathtub drain.
A hand gently lifting accumulated hair off the perforated top dome of the hair catcher after a shower.
Clean, dry shower drain with the catcher in place. Text overlay: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'

script_record.cta: A simple upgrade for everyday use.
